sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 268.6 ± 26.3 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe the same construct, SP-Y5R-2xHA, in which a double-HA epitope is appended to the C-terminus of NPY5R. The topology landmarks place the C-terminal span (429–445) entirely in the intracellular compartment, so this tag is on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface-tag site. The cleavable HA signal peptide mentioned in L1 is a trafficking enhancement device, not a tag at an extracellular position. No ledger line reports any insertion — epitope tag, fluorescent protein, transposon, or otherwise — at an extracellular position of NPY5R or a close ortholog. Zero qualifying sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: Double-HA epitope appended to the C-terminus (residue 445, intracellular span 429–445) in the SP-Y5R-2xHA construct; tag faces the cytoplasm and cannot serve as an extracellular surface label.
